patch_description: The current program converges to a shared local basin (ratio^2 ≈ 0.24) from icosahedron/cube/random starts. I add three new structured seed families per the recommendation — cuboctahedron vertices + 2 poles, a 14-point Fibonacci spiral, and swept-pole icosahedron variants (poles along x/y/z with pz ∈ {1.0, 1.2, 1.5}) — plus jittered copies of each. The existing annealed soft-min/max L-BFGS refinement plus exact-ratio polish is retained, but with slightly longer anneal schedules (extra low temperature T=0.005) and more restarts from the best solution (perturbation polish). Since selection is by true squared ratio, new seeds can only help escape the basin, and the extra polish restarts exploit the best candidate found.
